title: Check a JSON body
summary: FastAPI: Check a JSON body. Try pages equal to zero.
introduction: A Pydantic model describes body fields. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip","pages":24}.
learningObjectives: Check a JSON body with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Check a JSON body

blocks.text: Pydantic builds a Book after checking the input. The returned model contains its title and positive page count.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Positive page counts need a rule such as gt=0.
